kmm.name: Kröller-Müller Museum
kmm.slogan: Van Goghs hung in a forest clearing.
kmm.line: But I cannot help thinking that the best way of knowing God is to love many things.
kmm.by: Vincent van Gogh, letter to Theo, Cuesmes, July 1880

johnfrost.name: John Frost Bridge
johnfrost.slogan: The bridge too far, standing again over the Rhine.
johnfrost.line: Bombed to ruins in October 1944, it was rebuilt in the original style and reopened in 1948.

hetloo.name: Paleis Het Loo
hetloo.slogan: A royal hunting lodge dressed as a baroque dream.
hetloo.line: William III bought the old castle of Het Oude Loo in 1684 and built this palace beside it.

burgers.name: Burgers' Bush
burgers.slogan: A rainforest under glass, right in Gelderland.
burgers.line: Opened in 1988, this 1.5-hectare indoor rainforest sparked a revolution in how zoos show animals.

valkhof.name: Valkhof Chapel
valkhof.slogan: Charlemagne's hill, one small chapel still standing.
valkhof.line: Ordered around 1030 by Emperor Conrad II, it is the only part of the imperial Valkhof castle to survive intact.
